dlg.prologue.1: narrator|Long ago, the five kingdoms of Crystalheim lived in harmony, bound together by the Heart Crystal.
dlg.prologue.2: narrator|Then Valdorax, the Crystal Dragon, woke beneath the Citadel and drank its light.
dlg.prologue.3: valdorax|Every crystal will crack. Every kingdom will kneel.
dlg.prologue.4: narrator|In the snowy village of Frostvale, a young Crusher discovers a rare gift: matching shards breaks the dragon's corruption.
dlg.prologue.5: hero|If no one else will stand up to him… then I will.
dlg.ch1.intro.1: narrator|Frostvale, at the edge of Frostreach. Corrupted shards are raining from the sky.
dlg.ch1.intro.2: hero|These crystals are turning black… I can feel them humming.
dlg.ch1.intro.3: hero|Line them up, crush them: that's how I'll cleanse them.
dlg.ch1.mid.1: hero|A creature made of ice shards! It's guarding the village well.
dlg.ch1.mid.2: narrator|The shards obey a will that is not their own.
dlg.ch1.mid.3: hero|Then I'll break that will, one match at a time.
dlg.ch1.outro.1: narrator|The village is safe, for now. The elders speak of a shrine high in the mountains.
dlg.ch1.outro.2: hero|If the corruption comes from there, that's where I'm going.
dlg.ch2.intro.1: narrator|The Frost Shrine clings to the mountainside, its crystal heart split in two.
dlg.ch2.intro.2: hero|Someone came here before me. The seal was broken on purpose.
dlg.ch2.intro.3: hero|Footprints… and traces of elemental magic.
dlg.ch2.mid.1: hero|The shrine guardians attack anyone who comes close!
dlg.ch2.mid.2: narrator|Their eyes shine with the dragon's violet light.
dlg.ch2.mid.3: hero|Sorry, old guardians. I'll set you free.
dlg.ch2.outro.1: hero|The seal is holding again, but not for long.
dlg.ch2.outro.2: narrator|On the altar lies a sigil of the Frost Academy.
dlg.ch2.outro.3: hero|The Academy, then. Maybe someone there knows what's going on.
dlg.ch3.intro.1: narrator|The Frost Academy, where mages learn to shape ice and wind.
dlg.ch3.intro.2: hero|The halls are empty… Where is everyone?
dlg.ch3.intro.3: narrator|Somewhere above, a spell explodes in a storm of snow.
dlg.lyra.join.1: narrator|A young mage bursts out of the snowstorm, fighting a frost golem alone.
dlg.lyra.join.2: lyra|Don't just stand there, Crusher! Help me!
dlg.ch3.mid.1: lyra|I'm Lyra, apprentice of the Academy. You fight well for someone with no magic.
dlg.ch3.mid.2: hero|I don't need magic. I just need a clear board.
dlg.ch3.mid.3: lyra|Then let's clear this one together.
dlg.ch3.outro.1: lyra|The archmages fled when the Academy's crystal went dark.
dlg.ch3.outro.2: hero|The sigil at the shrine came from here. Do you know who used it?
dlg.ch3.outro.3: lyra|…No. Let's keep moving. Snow is closing the pass to the capital.
dlg.ch4.intro.1: narrator|The mountain pass is overrun with frost wolves.
dlg.ch4.intro.2: lyra|The royal guard should be defending this road.
dlg.ch4.intro.3: hero|Unless the guard is in trouble too.
dlg.ch4.mid.2: lyra|Hold on, I'll melt the edges. Crush the rest!
dlg.ch4.mid.3: narrator|One by one, the frozen guards are freed.
dlg.kael.join.1: narrator|A tall knight, half frozen, breaks free from the ice with a roar.
dlg.kael.join.2: kael|The last guard of the pass still stands! Who goes there?
dlg.kael.join.3: hero|Friends. Let's clear the rest of this pass together.
dlg.ch4.outro.1: kael|Captain Kael of the Northern Guard. I owe you my life, Crusher.
dlg.ch4.outro.2: kael|Queen Frostbane has sealed the capital. She says the dragon speaks to her.
dlg.ch4.outro.3: hero|Then we go to the capital. Together.
dlg.ch5.intro.1: kael|The wolves hunt in packs. Something is leading them.
dlg.ch5.intro.2: lyra|That howl… it sounds almost human.
dlg.ch5.intro.3: hero|Stay close. We break through at dawn.
dlg.ch5.mid.1: kael|There! The pack leader, wrapped in black crystal!
dlg.ch5.mid.2: hero|Its armor is made of shards. Perfect.
dlg.ch5.outro.1: narrator|The pack scatters into the snow. The road to the capital is open.
dlg.ch5.outro.2: kael|You two fight like you've known each other for years.
dlg.ch6.intro.1: lyra|The Great Library of Frostreach. If there's a record of Valdorax, it's here.
dlg.ch6.mid.1: kael|The ink is moving! The pages are attacking us!
dlg.ch6.mid.2: hero|Corrupted words? This world keeps getting stranger.
dlg.ch6.outro.1: lyra|Here: “The dragon sleeps as long as the Heart Crystal stays whole.”
dlg.ch6.outro.2: hero|So someone cracked it on purpose.
dlg.ch7.intro.1: narrator|A storm with a will of its own blocks the road.
dlg.ch7.intro.2: kael|No natural blizzard blows against the wind.
dlg.ch7.intro.3: hero|Then it's another one of the dragon's tricks.
dlg.ch7.mid.1: lyra|I can hold the wind back for a moment!
dlg.ch7.mid.3: narrator|Shards spin in the storm like angry stars.
dlg.ch7.outro.1: kael|The walls of the capital. Home.
dlg.ch7.outro.3: hero|We'll give it back to you, Kael. I promise.
dlg.ch8.intro.1: narrator|Inside the capital, citizens stand frozen in mid-step.
dlg.ch8.intro.2: kael|My Queen would never allow this…
dlg.ch8.mid.1: hero|The royal guards serve her blindly now.
dlg.ch8.mid.2: kael|They're my brothers. Don't hurt them. Free them.
dlg.ch8.mid.3: hero|That's the only way I fight.
dlg.ch8.outro.1: narrator|A voice echoes through the palace, cold and proud.
dlg.ch8.outro.2: valdorax|Frostbane is mine. Soon, the whole North will be.
dlg.ch9.intro.1: lyra|The Queen draws her power from the Eternal Glacier.
dlg.ch9.intro.2: kael|If we crack its corrupted core, she'll weaken.
dlg.ch9.mid.1: hero|The ice here is centuries thick.
dlg.ch9.mid.2: lyra|Match fast. The glacier refreezes behind us.
dlg.ch9.mid.3: kael|Keep going! I've got your back.
dlg.ch9.outro.1: narrator|The glacier's core shatters in a burst of blue light.
dlg.ch9.outro.2: hero|I felt something… like a scream from far away.
dlg.ch9.outro.3: lyra|That was Valdorax. He felt it too.
dlg.ch10.intro.1: kael|The throne room. Stay behind me.
dlg.ch10.intro.2: valdorax|Kneel, Crusher, or freeze with the rest.
dlg.ch10.intro.3: hero|I've come too far to kneel now.
dlg.ch10.mid.1: lyra|Frostbane's armor is fused with dragon crystal!
dlg.ch10.mid.2: hero|Every shard I break loosens his grip on her.
dlg.ch10.outro.1: narrator|The black crystal falls from Queen Frostbane like dead leaves.
dlg.ch10.outro.3: hero|The North is safe. But the corruption is spreading east, to Sunspire.
dlg.ch11.intro.1: narrator|Beyond the mountains, the snow gives way to endless golden dunes.
dlg.ch11.intro.2: kael|I've never been this far from home.
dlg.ch11.intro.3: lyra|Drink water. The sun here is as dangerous as any dragon.
dlg.ch11.mid.1: hero|The sand is swallowing the road!
dlg.ch11.mid.3: hero|Crystal-backed scorpions. They'll crack like the rest.
dlg.ch11.outro.1: narrator|The spires of the sun city rise on the horizon.
dlg.ch11.outro.2: lyra|Sunspire. The kingdom of healers and thieves.
dlg.ch11.outro.3: kael|Mostly thieves, from what I've heard.
dlg.ch12.intro.1: narrator|The great market of Sunspire, where anything can be bought.
dlg.ch12.intro.2: hero|Everyone's selling crystal shards. Corrupted ones!
dlg.ch12.intro.3: lyra|They have no idea what they're handling.
dlg.ch12.mid.1: kael|My purse! Someone just stole my purse!
dlg.ch12.mid.2: hero|A hooded figure, running across the rooftops!
dlg.ch12.outro.1: narrator|The thief vanishes into the crowd, leaving a single clean crystal behind.
dlg.ch12.outro.2: hero|She left this on purpose. A message?
dlg.ch13.intro.1: kael|We've tracked her to the old caravan ruins.
dlg.ch13.intro.2: hero|If she's collecting clean crystals, she might be on our side.
dlg.ch13.intro.3: lyra|Or she wants them for herself.
dlg.mira.join.1: mira|Stop following me! …Oh. You're the Crusher everyone's talking about.
dlg.mira.join.2: mira|Fine. Help me with these guards and I'll tell you what I know.
dlg.mira.join.3: kael|Give me back my purse first.
dlg.ch13.mid.1: mira|All right, you caught me. Mira, scout and occasional thief.
dlg.ch13.mid.2: mira|I steal corrupted shards before the merchants can sell them. You're welcome.
dlg.ch13.outro.1: mira|I have something you'll want: a map of every crystal vault in the East.
dlg.choice.trust_mira.1: mira|The map is real. But I got it from someone who works for the dragon.
dlg.choice.trust_mira.2: kael|She admits she deals with our enemy!
dlg.choice.trust_mira.3: hero|Or she takes the risks we can't.
dlg.ch14.intro.1: mira|The Sun Temple. Nobody has seen its healers in weeks.
dlg.ch14.intro.2: lyra|Something is draining the temple's light.
dlg.ch14.mid.2: mira|Don't look them in the eyes.
dlg.ch14.mid.3: kael|Who looks a guardian in the eyes?!
dlg.thorin.join.1: narrator|In the inner sanctum, an old paladin kneels behind a cracked shield, surrounded by corrupted guardians.
dlg.thorin.join.2: thorin|Light, give me strength… one last time.
dlg.ch14.outro.1: thorin|Peace, young ones. I am Thorin, last paladin of the Sun Temple.
dlg.ch14.outro.2: thorin|You freed my brothers. My shield and my healing are yours.
dlg.ch15.intro.1: thorin|The canyon is the only road to the southern oases.
dlg.ch15.intro.2: mira|It's also a nest of giant scorpions.
dlg.ch15.mid.1: thorin|Stay in the shade. I'll heal your burns.
dlg.ch15.mid.2: hero|There are more shards in these walls than sand!
dlg.ch15.outro.1: narrator|At the bottom of the canyon, an ancient mural shows a dragon… and a mage.
dlg.ch16.intro.1: mira|The Oasis of Zahir. Perfect water, perfect shade… too perfect.
dlg.ch16.mid.1: kael|Everyone I see here looks like someone I've lost.
dlg.ch16.mid.2: thorin|Hold on to the truth, Captain. It's a mirage.
dlg.ch16.mid.3: hero|Match the real shards. Ignore the rest.
dlg.ch16.outro.1: narrator|The mirage shatters. The oasis is dry and full of dark crystals.
dlg.ch16.outro.2: mira|Someone planted these here on purpose.
dlg.ch17.intro.1: thorin|The Sun Kings sealed a fragment of the Heart Crystal in their tomb.
dlg.ch17.intro.2: mira|Which means traps. Lots of traps.
dlg.ch17.mid.2: mira|I hate tombs. I really, really hate tombs.
dlg.ch17.mid.3: hero|Keep matching! They crumble with the shards!
dlg.ch17.outro.1: narrator|The fragment is safe, glowing with a warm light.
dlg.ch17.outro.2: thorin|This piece of the Heart must never fall into the dragon's claws.
dlg.ch17.outro.3: valdorax|Keep it warm for me, little paladin.
dlg.ch18.intro.1: narrator|Smoke on the horizon: a refugee caravan is under attack.
dlg.ch18.intro.2: kael|Move! There are children in those wagons!
dlg.ch18.mid.1: thorin|I'll protect the wounded. Clear the path!
dlg.ch18.mid.2: mira|Ember vultures! They're diving at the wagons!
dlg.ch18.outro.1: narrator|The refugees are safe. An old woman takes Lyra's hand.
dlg.ch18.outro.2: narrator|“You have your mother's eyes, child. She came here years ago… bearing the dragon's mark.”
dlg.ch18.outro.3: lyra|You must be mistaken. Please… let's go.
dlg.ch19.intro.1: mira|The eclipse cult is gathering at the Obsidian Pyramid.
dlg.ch19.intro.2: thorin|They want to use the eclipse to wake more of the dragon's power.
dlg.ch19.mid.2: lyra|The shards grow stronger in the dark. Be careful!
dlg.ch19.mid.3: hero|Stay together. We finish this before the sun is gone.
dlg.ch19.outro.1: narrator|The rite is broken, but the High Priest smiles as he falls.
dlg.ch19.outro.2: narrator|“Ask your mage what her mother did, Crusher.”
dlg.ch19.outro.3: hero|Lyra… what is he talking about?
dlg.ch20.intro.1: lyra|I… I need to tell you something. After this battle.
dlg.ch20.intro.2: kael|Lyra, whatever it is, we're with you.
dlg.ch20.mid.1: thorin|The Eclipse Pharaoh rises! He's absorbing the fragment's light!
dlg.ch20.mid.2: lyra|No more running. I'll face him.
dlg.ch20.outro.1: narrator|The Eclipse Pharaoh crumbles into sand. The East is free.
dlg.ch20.outro.2: lyra|My mother was the mage who cracked the Heart Crystal. She thought she could control its power.
dlg.ch20.outro.3: lyra|Valdorax woke because of her. And I've heard his voice in my dreams ever since.
dlg.choice.lyra_truth.1: kael|You hid this from us all this time?
dlg.choice.lyra_truth.2: thorin|She carried a weight no child should carry.
dlg.choice.lyra_truth.3: lyra|Whatever you decide… I'll accept it.
dlg.ch21.intro.1: narrator|West of the dunes lie the Verdant Wilds, a forest older than the kingdoms.
dlg.ch21.intro.2: thorin|The trees are sick. I can feel their pain.
dlg.ch21.intro.3: hero|Crystal roots… the corruption is in the soil.
dlg.ch21.outro.1: narrator|Deep in the woods, drums echo. Someone is watching the party.
dlg.ch21.outro.3: hero|Good. Maybe they know the way.
dlg.ch22.intro.1: thorin|Listen. The trees are whispering names.
dlg.ch22.intro.3: hero|They're warning us. Something is coming.
dlg.ch22.outro.1: narrator|The whispers fall silent. A path of glowing moss opens before them.
dlg.ch22.outro.3: mira|Great. Can the forest give us dinner too?
dlg.ch23.intro.1: lyra|An ancient city, swallowed by roots.
dlg.ch23.intro.2: hero|The crystals here are older. Purer.
dlg.ch23.intro.3: kael|Then why are they turning black?
dlg.ch23.mid.1: mira|Traps again. Why is it always traps?
dlg.ch23.mid.3: hero|Break the source and the spores will fade.
dlg.ch23.outro.1: narrator|In the heart of the ruins, a statue of a hunter points west.
dlg.ch23.outro.2: hero|The villagers talked about a ranger who fights the blight alone.
dlg.ch24.intro.1: mira|Arrows in the trees. Perfectly placed.
dlg.ch24.intro.3: hero|Or leading us into an ambush.
dlg.ch24.mid.2: thorin|An arrow just saved my life. Where did it come from?
dlg.ch24.outro.1: narrator|A figure in green lands silently in front of the party.
dlg.ch24.outro.2: narrator|“Outsiders. You're either very brave or very stupid.”
dlg.ch24.outro.3: hero|A bit of both, I think.
dlg.ch25.intro.1: narrator|The ranger blocks the path to the Heartwood.
dlg.ch25.intro.2: narrator|“Nobody passes without proving their worth.”
dlg.ch25.mid.1: kael|She wants a contest: whoever breaks the most corrupted crystals wins.
dlg.ch25.mid.2: mira|I bet on you, Crusher. Don't make me lose money.
dlg.zara.join.1: zara|Last round of the wager, Crusher. Win this one and I'll follow you.
dlg.zara.join.3: zara|Then you carry my gear all the way to the Heartwood.
dlg.ch25.outro.1: zara|You won. Barely. I'm Zara, hunter of the Wilds.
dlg.ch25.outro.2: zara|The blight took my village. If you're going after the dragon, my bow is yours.
dlg.ch26.intro.1: zara|Blight beasts are marching on Thornwall, the last refugee town.
dlg.ch26.mid.2: zara|Take down the crystal alphas and the rest will flee!
dlg.ch26.mid.3: thorin|Stand firm! The light protects the brave!
dlg.ch26.outro.1: narrator|The horde retreats, but the town's walls lie in ruins.
dlg.ch26.outro.2: thorin|These people have no healer and no protector.
dlg.thorin.leave.1: thorin|My friends, my road ends here. Thornwall needs a protector more than you need an old man.
dlg.thorin.leave.2: thorin|Carry this light with you. It will heal you when I can't.
dlg.thorin.leave.3: hero|We'll come back for you, Thorin. When it's over.
dlg.thorin.leave.4: narrator|Thorin raises his shield in farewell as the party walks away.
dlg.ch27.intro.2: mira|I miss his terrible jokes. Don't tell him.
dlg.ch27.intro.3: zara|The spore fields are ahead. Hold your breath.
dlg.ch27.mid.1: lyra|The spores are showing me visions… my mother.
dlg.ch27.mid.2: hero|It's not real, Lyra. Stay with me.
dlg.ch27.mid.3: zara|Crush the fungal hearts and the visions will stop!
dlg.ch27.outro.1: narrator|The spore fields crumble to dust.
dlg.ch27.outro.2: lyra|Thank you for pulling me back.
dlg.ch28.intro.1: zara|The Druid's Grove. Only the shamans know how to heal the Heartwood.
dlg.ch28.intro.3: narrator|The grove is silent, covered in crystal frost.
dlg.elian.join.1: narrator|A young shaman sits motionless at the center of the grove, speaking to the trees.
dlg.elian.join.2: elian|Shh. The spirits tell me you're friends.
dlg.elian.join.3: elian|Help me drive the blight out of the grove, and I'll walk with you.
dlg.ch28.mid.1: elian|The forest told me you'd come. I'm Elian, the last shaman of the grove.
dlg.ch28.mid.2: elian|The Heartwood is dying. I can't save it alone.
dlg.ch28.outro.1: elian|Your gift doesn't destroy crystals. It frees them.
dlg.ch28.outro.2: hero|I've never thought of it like that.
dlg.ch28.outro.3: lyra|Freeing, not destroying… Maybe that's the key to everything.
dlg.ch29.intro.1: elian|The Heartwood. The oldest tree in Crystalheim.
dlg.ch29.intro.2: zara|Its bark is turning into black glass.
dlg.ch29.intro.3: hero|Show us where to strike, Elian.
dlg.ch29.mid.1: elian|The roots are the source! Follow the dark veins!
dlg.ch29.outro.1: narrator|Light returns to the Heartwood's leaves, but its heart still beats with dark crystal.
dlg.ch29.outro.2: elian|Something is protecting the corruption from within.
dlg.ch29.outro.3: zara|The Elder Treant. The forest's guardian… turned.
dlg.ch30.intro.1: elian|Forgive us, ancient one. We have come to heal you.
dlg.ch30.intro.2: valdorax|The forest is mine, shaman. Its guardian obeys me.
dlg.ch30.mid.1: zara|It's crushing everything in its path!
dlg.ch30.mid.2: kael|Its heart! There, in the trunk!
dlg.ch30.outro.1: narrator|The Elder Treant bows, its bark green again. The Wilds breathe once more.
dlg.ch30.outro.2: elian|The guardian thanks you. The West is free.
dlg.ch30.outro.3: lyra|Two kingdoms left. The South… and Crystalheim itself.
dlg.ch31.intro.1: narrator|The South: Emberfall, a land of volcanoes, forges and ash.
dlg.ch31.intro.2: zara|I can't even see the sky.
dlg.ch31.intro.3: mira|Emberfall is famous for its assassins. Keep your purse close, Kael.
dlg.ch31.mid.2: elian|The fire spirits are in pain. The corruption burns them.
dlg.ch31.outro.1: narrator|The Ashen Gates open onto a city of black stone.
dlg.ch31.outro.2: lyra|The dragon's voice is louder here.
dlg.ch31.outro.3: hero|Then we're getting close to his forges.
dlg.ch32.intro.1: zara|The only bridge over the lava river is guarded.
dlg.ch32.intro.3: narrator|The river swells, and something enormous moves beneath it.
dlg.ch32.mid.2: elian|Don't let it touch the bridge!
dlg.ch32.mid.3: kael|The bridge is on fire. Match faster!
dlg.ch32.outro.1: narrator|The serpent sinks back into the magma.
dlg.ch32.outro.3: mira|From now on, I walk on the other side of the bridge.
dlg.ch33.intro.1: mira|The black market of Emberfall. Corrupted crystal weapons everywhere.
dlg.ch33.intro.3: hero|Someone with a forge and the dragon's favor.
dlg.ch33.mid.1: zara|The merchants' guards are coming for us!
dlg.ch33.mid.2: mira|I may have borrowed a few things.
dlg.ch33.outro.1: narrator|Among the goods, the party finds forge seals marked with a claw.
dlg.ch33.outro.2: elian|The Forge of Echoes. Deep inside the volcano.
dlg.ch33.outro.3: hero|That's where the weapons come from.
dlg.ch34.intro.1: kael|The forge hammers are beating on their own.
dlg.ch34.intro.2: lyra|They're forging crystal armor for an army.
dlg.ch34.intro.3: hero|Then we shut the forge down.
dlg.ch34.mid.2: elian|Their cores are pure corrupted crystal.
dlg.ch34.outro.1: narrator|The forge falls silent. On the wall hangs a list of names: Valdorax's chosen agents.
dlg.ch35.intro.1: mira|The Shade's assassins are hunting us now.
dlg.ch35.intro.2: zara|I can't see them in the smoke.
dlg.ch35.mid.2: elian|The wind spirits can reveal them!
dlg.ch35.mid.3: lyra|Now, while we can see them!
dlg.ch35.outro.1: narrator|The assassins retreat, leaving a black feather behind.
dlg.ch35.outro.2: mira|The Shade's mark. We've been warned.
dlg.ch36.intro.1: narrator|To reach the dragon's southern stronghold, the party must cross a labyrinth of lava.
dlg.ch36.intro.2: elian|The paths change with every eruption.
dlg.ch36.mid.3: hero|Follow the shards. They all flow toward the stronghold.
dlg.ch36.outro.1: narrator|Exhausted, the party reaches a dead end at the edge of a cliff.
dlg.ch36.outro.3: narrator|A voice rises from the smoke: “I know a way.”
dlg.ch37.intro.1: narrator|A stranger in a grey cloak waits in the ash.
dlg.ch37.intro.3: hero|Wait. If he wanted us dead, he'd have done it already.
dlg.ch37.mid.1: narrator|The stranger fights at the party's side against the ash wraiths.
dlg.ch37.mid.3: mira|I don't like him. I can't explain why.
dlg.ch37.outro.1: narrator|The stranger lowers his hood. “My name is Mark. I hate the dragon as much as you do.”
dlg.ch37.outro.2: elian|The spirits fall silent around him. That's unusual.
dlg.ch37.outro.3: hero|We need a guide. Let's see where he leads us.
dlg.ch38.intro.1: narrator|Mark leads the party through hidden tunnels beneath the volcano.
dlg.ch38.intro.2: mira|How does he know every secret passage around here?
dlg.ch38.intro.3: lyra|Keep your eyes open. All of you.
dlg.mark.join.1: mark|The lava paths shift with every eruption. Without me, you'll die in the labyrinth.
dlg.mark.join.3: mark|With me, you might reach the stronghold. That's the best I can offer.
dlg.ch38.mid.1: mark|The guardians are exactly where I said they'd be.
dlg.ch38.mid.3: mira|Perfect. That's exactly what worries me.
dlg.ch38.outro.2: narrator|Mark draws a black blade and lunges at the Crusher's back.
dlg.mira.leave.2: narrator|Mira throws herself between the blade and the Crusher.
dlg.mira.leave.3: mira|Heh… I finally stole something worth keeping… your life.
dlg.mark.leave.2: narrator|Disarmed and bound by Kael and Zara, Mark falls to his knees.
dlg.mark.leave.3: mark|He holds my family prisoner in crystal. I had no choice… I never had a choice.
dlg.choice.spare_mark.1: zara|Mira is dead because of him. He deserves to die.
dlg.choice.spare_mark.2: elian|Death answers nothing. It won't bring her back.
dlg.choice.spare_mark.3: lyra|I know what it's like to live in the dragon's shadow. The choice is yours.
dlg.ch39.intro.1: narrator|The party buries Mira beneath a black stone that glows faintly.
dlg.ch39.intro.2: kael|She stole my purse the day we met. I'd give anything to have it stolen again.
dlg.ch39.mid.1: zara|Pyraxis's army is on our heels!
dlg.ch39.mid.2: elian|Channel your anger, but don't let it consume you.
dlg.ch39.outro.2: hero|Every time I close my eyes, I see her jump.
dlg.ch39.outro.3: lyra|Then let us carry some of it. You're not alone.
dlg.ch40.intro.1: narrator|Pyraxis, the Molten King, awaits on his volcanic throne.
dlg.ch40.intro.2: valdorax|Burn them, Pyraxis. Leave nothing behind.
dlg.ch40.mid.1: zara|His crown is a lava crystal!
dlg.ch40.mid.2: elian|Break it and his fire will go out!
dlg.ch40.outro.1: narrator|Pyraxis falls. The South is free, at a terrible cost.
dlg.ch40.outro.2: narrator|From the ruins of the forge, an eccentric man in goggles steps out, clapping.
dlg.ch40.outro.3: soren|Magnificent! I'm Soren, alchemist. I know how to purify the Heart Crystal. Will you take me along?
dlg.choice.recruit_soren.1: zara|He worked in the dragon's forges. How can we trust him?
dlg.choice.recruit_soren.2: elian|His formulas could heal the Heartwood too.
dlg.choice.recruit_soren.3: kael|After Mark… I don't know who to trust anymore.
dlg.ch41.intro.1: narrator|Crystalheim, the heart kingdom. Its sky shimmers like broken glass.
dlg.ch41.intro.2: lyra|The dragon's voice never stops now.
dlg.ch41.intro.3: hero|Then let's silence him for good.
dlg.soren.join.1: soren|Excellent decision! My mixtures are at your service.
dlg.soren.join.2: soren|Don't touch the green flask. Or the blue one. Actually, don't touch anything.
dlg.soren.join.3: zara|This is going to be a long trip.
dlg.ch41.outro.1: narrator|The towers of the Crystal Citadel appear, circled by storms.
dlg.ch41.outro.2: elian|Every living thing here is afraid.
dlg.ch42.intro.1: zara|The light here burns like fire.
dlg.ch42.intro.2: elian|The land itself is made of crystal.
dlg.ch42.intro.3: hero|Stay out of the beams of light.
dlg.ch42.mid.1: kael|Mirror specters! They copy our moves!
dlg.ch42.mid.2: lyra|Then do what they don't expect!
dlg.ch42.mid.3: hero|Chain a cascade. They can't copy that.
dlg.ch42.outro.1: narrator|At the end of the Wastes stands a ruined city of glass.
dlg.ch42.outro.2: lyra|The city of the old kings. My mother studied here.
dlg.ch43.intro.1: lyra|My mother's laboratory. Her notes are still here.
dlg.ch43.intro.3: lyra|“The dragon was not always a monster. The crystal corrupted him first.”
dlg.ch43.mid.1: zara|The ghosts of the old kings are guarding the archives!
dlg.ch43.mid.2: elian|They're lost souls. Free them gently.
dlg.ch43.outro.1: lyra|Valdorax was the guardian of the Heart Crystal. The corruption turned him into a tyrant.
dlg.ch43.outro.2: hero|So if the crystal can be purified…
dlg.ch44.intro.1: narrator|The Mirror Legion marches on the last free villages of Crystalheim.
dlg.ch44.intro.2: kael|Thousands of soldiers made of glass.
dlg.ch44.intro.3: hero|Then we'll need thousands of matches.
dlg.ch44.mid.1: zara|Their general is commanding from the rear!
dlg.ch44.mid.2: elian|Cut off the head and the body falls.
dlg.ch44.outro.1: narrator|The legion shatters like a dropped mirror.
dlg.ch44.outro.2: kael|The villagers are coming out of hiding. They're cheering for us.
dlg.ch44.outro.3: hero|We're not heroes yet. Not until the dragon falls.
dlg.ch45.intro.1: zara|Someone is following us. I've felt it for days.
dlg.ch45.intro.2: elian|The spirits say it's a shadow full of regret.
dlg.ch45.mid.1: narrator|Crystal hunters ambush the party in a narrow canyon.
dlg.ch45.mid.3: narrator|Several of them fall before they reach the party, struck by unseen blades.
dlg.mark.return.1: mark|Don't draw your weapons. I'm not here to fight.
dlg.mark.return.2: mark|I freed my family. Now my life belongs to your quest. Let me make up for what I destroyed.
dlg.mark.return.3: hero|Nothing will bring Mira back. But you can honor her. Walk in front, where we can see you.
dlg.ch45.outro.1: narrator|The road to the Citadel's outer walls is clear.
dlg.ch45.outro.2: lyra|Whatever happens next, I'm glad I'm facing it with you.
dlg.ch46.intro.1: narrator|A storm of crystal shards surrounds the Citadel.
dlg.ch46.intro.2: elian|No living creature can cross it.
dlg.ch46.intro.3: hero|I'm not planning to cross it. I'm planning to crush it.
dlg.ch46.mid.3: lyra|I'll shield us as long as I can!
dlg.ch46.outro.1: narrator|The storm breaks. For the first time in years, sunlight touches the Citadel.
dlg.ch46.outro.2: valdorax|You dare… You dare bring light into my home!
dlg.ch47.intro.1: elian|A sanctuary of the old guardians, untouched by the corruption.
dlg.ch47.intro.2: kael|We can rest here. Just for one night.
dlg.ch47.mid.1: narrator|Corrupted wyverns attack the sanctuary at dawn.
dlg.ch47.outro.1: narrator|That night, the party gathers around the fire.
dlg.ch47.outro.2: kael|Whatever happens, it's been an honor.
dlg.ch47.outro.3: lyra|Don't talk like we're going to die.
dlg.ch48.intro.1: narrator|The freed kingdoms have sent their armies: Frostbane's knights, Sunspire's healers, the rangers of the Wilds.
dlg.ch48.intro.2: kael|My Queen came! The North stands with us!
dlg.ch48.intro.3: hero|Then let's open the gates for them.
dlg.ch48.mid.2: elian|The Heartwood sent its spirits to help us!
dlg.ch48.outro.1: narrator|The gates of the Citadel fall. The allied armies pour inside.
dlg.ch48.outro.2: lyra|The Heart Crystal is at the top of the tower.
dlg.ch48.outro.3: hero|And Valdorax is waiting for us.
dlg.ch49.intro.1: narrator|The tower rises through the clouds, pulsing with violet light.
dlg.ch49.intro.2: valdorax|Come, Crusher. Climb to your end.
dlg.ch49.intro.3: kael|He does like to talk, doesn't he?
dlg.ch49.mid.1: lyra|The Heart Warden! My mother's last creation!
dlg.ch49.mid.2: elian|It guards the crystal, even against its creator's daughter.
dlg.ch49.mid.3: hero|Lyra, you don't have to fight it.
dlg.ch49.outro.1: narrator|The Heart Crystal floats above the summit, cracked and bleeding darkness.
dlg.ch49.outro.2: narrator|Behind it, an immense shape spreads its wings of crystal.
dlg.ch50.intro.1: valdorax|I guarded this crystal for a thousand years. Then it poisoned me.
dlg.ch50.intro.2: valdorax|Now the world will feel what I feel.
dlg.ch50.intro.3: hero|We know the truth. It doesn't have to end like this!
dlg.ch50.mid.1: kael|His scales grow back with every shard!
dlg.ch50.mid.2: lyra|Break them faster than he heals!
dlg.ch50.mid.3: hero|This is what I was born to do!
dlg.ch50.outro.1: narrator|Valdorax collapses, his wings cracked. The Heart Crystal flickers, unstable.
dlg.ch50.outro.2: valdorax|Finish it, Crusher. Or take its power… and become what I became.
dlg.choice.final_choice.1: narrator|If nothing is done, the Heart Crystal will explode and destroy the whole kingdom.
dlg.choice.final_choice.2: lyra|The crystal needs a heart to hold it together… or a will strong enough to purify it.
dlg.choice.final_choice.3: hero|Everything we've fought for comes down to this moment.
dlg.ending.sacrifice.1: narrator|The Crusher places both hands on the Heart Crystal and draws the corruption into their own body.
dlg.ending.sacrifice.3: narrator|A wave of pure light sweeps across Crystalheim. The dragon sleeps. The kingdoms heal.
dlg.ending.sacrifice.4: narrator|The Crusher is never seen again. But in every village, a crystal glows forever in their honor.
dlg.ending.corruption.1: narrator|The Crusher seizes the Heart Crystal. Its power floods their veins.
dlg.ending.corruption.3: narrator|Valdorax crumbles to dust, and a new ruler takes the throne of Crystalheim.
dlg.ending.corruption.4: narrator|The kingdoms are at peace, but they live in fear. And the crystals glow violet once more.
dlg.ending.redemption.1: lyra|My mother cracked this crystal. Let her daughter heal it.
dlg.ending.redemption.2: mark|And let a Shade bring back the light he helped steal.
dlg.ending.redemption.3: narrator|Lyra's magic, Mark's remorse and the Crusher's gift become one. The corruption melts away from the crystal… and from the dragon.
dlg.ending.redemption.4: valdorax|I remember… who I was. Thank you.
dlg.ending.redemption.5: narrator|Valdorax, guardian once more, watches over a united Crystalheim. And the heroes, at last, go home.
